info.title: Rizqim API
info.description:
Rizqim backend API (`/api/v1`): Telegram Mini App, ega/menejer/kuryer ekranlari va to'lov webhooklari.

**Kirish:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (Laravel Sanctum). Token `POST /v1/auth/telegram` orqali olinadi.

**Javob formati:** `{ "success": bool, "message": string, "data": ... }`. Xatolarda `success: false` va `message`;
validatsiya xatolari (422) `errors` maydonida keladi.

Spetsifikatsiya koddan yaratiladi: `cd backend && php artisan api-spec:export` (`packages/api-spec/openapi.json`).

Without a location the user's default address is used.

`unit` (piece|kg|l), `quantity_step` and `min_quantity`; products carry `batch_tracked`, `image_thumb_urls` and
`modifier_groups` (effective `min_select`/`max_select`/`is_required` for that product, active `modifiers` with
`price_delta`); hidden products/variants of the channel are left out. Store mode adds `availability`.

post.description:
Prices, stock, the promo code and the delivery fee are checked on the server. `payment_url` is set for online
payment methods (Click, Payme): open it to pay; the order is cancelled when it stays unpaid. 400 with the reason
when the order cannot be placed (store closed, item unavailable, minimum not reached...).

P1-21 (docs/MENU.md): `items.*.quantity` may be a fraction for items sold by weight (kg/l, at least
`min_quantity`, in `quantity_step` steps); `items.*.modifiers` lists the chosen modifiers as uuids or
`{id: uuid, quantity}`; prices always come from the server. 422 when a modifier rule is broken, the item is on
the branch's stop-list, its batch is sold out ("tugadi") or it is hidden on the channel. The channel is decided by
the server from the sign-in (P1-34): `mobile` for a token of a customer mobile app device, else `telegram`; a
`channel` in the body is accepted for older apps but ignored. `type=dine_in` is refused with 422 (hall orders
are taken by staff on the POS). An `Idempotency-Key` header makes retries safe: the same key with the same body
within 24 hours returns the first response (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`), with another body 409.

P1-32 (docs/ZONES.md): when the store has delivery zones, a `delivery` order is routed and priced by the zone
that covers `latitude`/`longitude`, exactly as `GET /delivery/quote` prices it: the zone's fee (free past its
threshold) and minimum order replace the store-wide ones, any fee the client sends is ignored. Without
`branch_id` the branch is picked automatically (the zone's branch, else the nearest open one); with it, that
branch must serve a zone covering the point. 422 with `data.reason`: `outside_zone`, `branch_outside_zone`,
`branch_closed`, or `below_minimum_order` (with `data.min_order_amount` and `data.subtotal`). Stores without
zones keep the branch radius rule and the store's delivery fee.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional: a new UUID per action, the same one when retrying it; a repeat returns the first answer.

quantity.description: P1-21: a fraction for items sold by weight (0.5 kg, at most 3 decimals); pieces stay whole (checked per unit)

channel.description: P1-34: accepted for older apps, ignored: the channel is the sign-in's (channelOf)

post.description:
The customer cancels their own order: only while it is new and unpaid (Order::isCancellableByCustomer), always
with the reason customer_request. Stock, promo use and the like come back as with any cancellation; a payment
arriving afterwards is refused by the payment webhooks. Returns the order as GET /orders lists it.
403/422 when the order's status or the user's role does not allow it.

Only the transitions the order's state machine allows; cancelling or rejecting needs a `reason`. Answers 200
with the unchanged order when it is already in that status; 403/422 when the transition is not allowed.

`period` is today|week|month|year (the last 1/7/30/365 calendar days of the store's time zone, P2-33) or custom with `from` and `to`

ones. All money is a number in UZS (two decimals at most). Cached for 60 s per store/branch and period.

`ip` is shown to the owner only.

A hall order (pos_hall) gets `quantity_per_guest` of each item per guest when it opens and when guests join
(pieces rounded up: 0.5 choynak per guest is 2 for 3 guests). A hall's own rule replaces the branch rule of the
same item in that hall; an inactive hall rule switches it off there.

`business_day_starts_at`: "HH:MM", the local time (`timezone` of the store) the business day starts, 05:00 unless
changed. `pos_settings`: every key, stored values over the defaults: `mode` counter|table|hybrid,
`printing_device_id` (uuid of the "chop etuvchi" kassa), `screen_lock_minutes` (0: never), `queue_numbers`,
`alerts` (`open_room_hours`, `void_amount`, `discount_percent`, `unaccepted_online_minutes`; null: off),
`holidays` (YYYY-MM-DD), `booking_slot_minutes` (null: the server default).

put.description:
Send only what changes. `business_day_starts_at`: "HH:MM" from 00:00 to 11:59 (an early opener may set 04:00).
`pos_settings`: `mode`; `printing_device_id` (uuid of a POS terminal of this branch, or null for none);
`screen_lock_minutes` 0-240; `queue_numbers`; `alerts` merges key by key (`open_room_hours` 1-72,
`void_amount` 0-100000000, `discount_percent` 0-100, `unaccepted_online_minutes` 1-120; null switches that alert
off); `holidays` replaces the whole list (up to 400 dates); `booking_slot_minutes` 30-1440 (how long a booking without an end
time holds its room; null: the server default). An unknown key is 422.

One or more `tenders` (a mixed payment), each with the `amount` it pays of the bill: `cash` (optional
`tendered_amount`: what the guest gave, the change is worked out), `card` (a separate bank terminal:
`card_type` — uzcard, humo, visa, mastercard, unionpay, mir, other — and the terminal's `transaction_id` are
required), `qr` (optional `reference`), `prepayment` (the booking's deposit, at most what is left of it, once
per bill), `account` (nasiya: `account_uuid`; needs customer_accounts.manage or a manager's `approval_token`;
once per bill). Payments may come in several requests; together they never exceed the bill (422 `overpayment`).
The money lands in the open shift of the terminal (or `shift_uuid`; 409 `shift_not_open`). When the bill is
covered, its sale receipt is asked for: the bill is `paid` once the receipt is issued (`fiscal.status`), and the
order is closed (delivered, paid, table free) once all its bills are. A receipt not issued yet leaves the bill
"fiskal kutmoqda" (`fiscal.status` pending or failed): retry with `.../fiscal-retry`. A line without MXIK: 422
`mxik_missing` before any money is taken. Optional `version`. Needs pos.take_payment.

and made again). `mode`: `single` (one bill), `equal` (`parts` bills with the same total; the remainder tiyin on
the first), `items` (`bills`: each with its `items` — `order_item_id` and `quantity`, fractions too, e.g. 0.5 of
1.5 kg; every line left must be given out in full; optional `guests` for the per-guest amount). The discount and
the charges (room fee, minimum spend top-up, service charge, place fee) are shared in proportion; all shares are
exact to the tiyin. `version`: the order's (409 `version_conflict` when stale). One bill: orders.manage or
pos.take_payment; splitting: pos.take_payment (403 `permission_denied`). A waiter bills only their own orders
(another waiter's: a manager's `approval_token` for orders.manage, else 403 `approval_required`). 409
`nothing_to_bill`, `order_closed`,

post.description:
The line is ready (kitchen.manage). The first bump of an accepted order starts it (preparing). When every line is
ready a delivery or pickup order becomes ready by itself; a hall order (dine_in) stays preparing until it is
closed. P2-33: a courier_assigned order (a courier was assigned while it was cooking) takes bumps too, with no
status move. 422 when the order is not in the kitchen (new, ready, on its way, finished). Bumping a ready line
again answers 200 unchanged. P3-26: a held pre-order line with a due time (fire_mode hold, `due_at`, not sent yet)
may be bumped before the till sends it — ready implies sent: it gets its station and `sent_at` now and the POS
order's version moves. Returns the ticket.

Undo a mistaken bump: the line is back to pending (kitchen.manage). While the order is accepted or preparing,
and (P2-30) while it is ready but not yet with a courier or handed over: the order goes back to preparing
(`order.status_changed` and the history say so). P2-33: while a courier is assigned (courier_assigned) the line
is recalled with no status move. 422 once it is on its way or finished. Returns the ticket.

By permission (docs/AUTH.md §6): orders.manage (owner, manager, cashier, waiter) accepts, starts, marks ready and
hands over (pickup, hall: delivered); a cook (kitchen.manage) only starts cooking (accepted → preparing) and marks
ready (preparing → ready); cancelling or rejecting needs orders.cancel and a `reason`. The order's state machine
decides what can follow what (422 otherwise). Couriers are assigned with POST /orders/{uuid}/assign-courier.
Marking an order ready marks all its lines ready in the kitchen. The same status again answers 200 unchanged.
P2-30: `on_the_way` (the assigned courier picked the order up: courier_assigned → on_the_way) with
orders.assign_courier; an order without an assigned courier is a 422 (assign one first).
